title: Types of APIs Explained Simply
intro: APIs are the backbone of modern applications. They help different software systems communicate and share data seamlessly.

slides.heading: REST API
slides.subtitle: The most widely used API type.
points: Uses HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Returns data mostly in JSON format

slides.heading: SOAP API
slides.subtitle: A protocol for secure, structured communication.
points: Highly secure with built-in error handling

slides.heading: GraphQL API
slides.subtitle: Ask for exactly the data you need.

slides.heading: WebSocket API
slides.subtitle: Two-way communication that stays open.
points: Persistent connection between client and server
Server can push data without a new request

slides.heading: gRPC API
slides.subtitle: Fast, typed communication between services.
points: Much faster than REST for service-to-service calls

cta: Which API have you used the most? Let me know in the comments.
